articles.title: Prediction Market Myriad Launches $100K World Cup Competition
articles.snippet: A prize pool of over $100,000 is available for top traders and makers on prediction markets linked to FIFA World Cup matches.

articles.title: ElevenLabs, Stability AI Drop New AI Music Models—Can They Catch Suno?
articles.snippet: Music v2 brings genre-shifting and section-by-section composition to ElevenLabs. Stable Audio 3.0 ships open weights and six-minute tracks. Is either good enough to dethrone the category leader?

articles.title: Marvel Comics Icon Stan Lee Has Been 'Revived' With AI Tech—Again
articles.snippet: ElevenLabs has licensed Stan Lee’s voice and likeness, adding the late Marvel comic creator to a growing market for AI celebrity replicas.

articles.title: DeepSeek, Xiaomi Just Made Frontier AI 99% Cheaper. American Labs Went the Other Way
articles.snippet: Back-to-back price cuts from China's top AI labs have made their models a fraction of the cost of GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus.

articles.title: YouTube Makes AI Content Labels More Prominent as Google Pushes Video Remix Tools
articles.snippet: YouTube says new disclosure tools and automatic AI detection will help viewers more easily identify AI-generated videos.
